River (rivergtm.com) | NYC, on-site | Founding Engineer + Product Engineer | Full-time

River builds voice AI agents for B2B comapnies. Our agent talks with prospects in real time, answers hard questions, and demos the product by actually controlling a browser while it speaks. Every call runs on a sub-second loop: speech, a rendered avatar, several LLMs, and a live browser-use agent, in front of real buyers. $2M pre-seed backed by founders of Ramp, Kalshi, and JumpCloud.

Hiring two roles:

Founding Engineer (5+ yrs): own the live-call pipeline (real-time voice, avatar, browser streaming) and the infra behind it. Looking for strong backend/infra plus real-time experience (WebRTC, voice/video, websockets). Stack: TypeScript, Node, Next.js, Postgres, Redis, LiveKit.

Product Engineer, full-stack (1-3 yrs or exceptional projects): build the services behind live calls, LLM workflows, and the browser-use agent that runs demos. Backend-leaning, TypeScript.

Both on-site in NYC, working directly with the founders. Try the product yourself at rivergtm.com/start

Proxima Fusion | Senior Software Engineer (Dev Platform) | Munich, Germany | ONSITE | Full-time

We're building the world's first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. First spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics, based on Wendelstein 7-X (the largest stellarator ever built), €650M+ raised, teams in Munich, Zurich and Oxford.

Finding a good stellarator design means searching an enormous high-dimensional space, and every candidate design needs heavy plasma physics simulation. That's the compute problem this role owns: cloud + HPC clusters, K8s, Ray, Dask, and the platform work around it (CI/CD, IaC, observability). You'd sit directly next to the physicists and AI researchers burning through that compute, so you see exactly what your infrastructure unlocks. Python and Linux.

If you've wanted to point your platform engineering skills at something that actually matters, clean, abundant energy, this is about as direct a shot as it gets, and it's happening in Europe.

Interview process: recruiter call, technical screen, technical panel, CEO call.

https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/proxima-fusion/5aebfef0-0c2c-4c87-9...

Friendly Captcha | Developer Relations | PART-TIME or FULL-TIME | Munich area, Germany | https://friendlycaptcha.com

Friendly Captcha is a growing, profitable, fully bootstrapped company. Our revenue mostly comes from medium to large European enterprise and governments. We have the feeling we can make ourselves known better to engineers and other builders to gain more bottom-up growth.

We're looking to strengthen our team with someone who will be focused on our Developer Relations (DevRel) and general marketing activities. We're a startup and this is a pretty mixed role that's hard to describe in one or two sentences. Form with more information: https://friendlycaptcha.jobs.personio.com/job/2686399

Shovels | Remote | Senior Data & Platform (Remote, Europe) | Senior Full-Stack Product (Remote, EU/US) | Full-time

Everyone building with AI is crowded into the digital world: dev tools, copilots, agents for software people. Meanwhile the largest asset class on earth, the built world, runs on records scattered across 20,000+ US jurisdictions, and most of those have no online portal at all. The only way in is a relationship and a public-records request, and you cannot download a relationship. We turned that into the intelligence layer for the built world: permits, contractors, parcels, government decisions. Customers pay for it today.

One warning about the careers page: the job posts have a reverse CAPTCHA. Read access: agents only. Bring yours: https://www.shovels.ai/careers

Try the door even if you don't plan to apply, I promise it's fun!

Receipts on how we build: we published the working notes from planning our newest API, rival architectures and refuted claims included: https://shovelsai.github.io/team-notes/2026-07-07-a9e2-how-w...

Do you want to make software cheaper to build, or build the thing that stays valuable when software is cheap? :)

Pango | Founding Software Engineer | On-site (hybrid) in Stockholm, Sweden (Visa Sponsorship possible) | Full time

Pango is building the world's first Agentic Operating System for e-commerce logistics. Our vision is to create the AI e-commerce employee of the future. We are forming our core team in Stockholm and are looking for exceptional engineers. We are backed by some of the most some of the most prominent investors in the world. * You are comfortable maintaining, expanding and operating an B2B SaaS platform with a high sense of ownership.

* You have previous experience working at a SaaS product company as a founding or senior engineer

Landjourney | Senior Full-Stack Engineer | Montreal, QC (hybrid, 2-3 days/week onsite) | Full-time | $160-170K CAD

We build lending software for agriculture: loan origination, automated document collection, white-labeled servicing portals, and a capital marketplace, sold to banks and credit unions. Seed stage, $4.5M raised, SOC 2 Type II.

Stack: Python/FastAPI, CockroachDB, Redis, Angular 22, Docker.

This is genuinely full-stack, and the front-end half is the part most candidates overstate, so we test it directly. Multi-step loan applications with cross-field validation, document collection interfaces, portals our lender clients rebrand as their own. Forms complex enough that state management is a real problem.

Our take-home is an agentic assignment. You pick one of three problems, use whatever AI tooling you like, and ship it running on Vercel. We do not care whether you wrote it unaided. We care whether you understood what came out. The full brief is public, so read it before applying and decide for yourself whether it is worth 2-3 hours: https://github.com/landjourney/agentic-assignment

After that, 45 minutes where you walk us through your code and add one requirement we did not tell you about in advance.

7+ years. French is an asset, not a requirement. No visa sponsorship.

Apply: https://app.dover.com/apply/Landjourney/e1083161-2682-4459-b...

Arsenal FC | Research Engineer | London Colney, UK | HYBRID | FULL-TIME

Yes, the 25/26 Premier League Champions! You'd be embedded with the Men's First Team analysis dept building the internal tooling analysts and coaches use day to day — full-stack apps plus applied ML to automate and augment football analysis. The fun part is the constraint: it has to be genuinely useful to coaching staff and hold up against a live training/matchday schedule, not just be technically neat.

Python / SQL / TypeScript, PyData stack (Pandas/Polars, Altair, etc.), PyTorch/JAX/TF. You'll own things end-to-end, data through UI.

Looking for strong quant background, first-principles engineering judgment, and taste in how insights get presented. Here's a taste of what the work looks like: https://x.com/karun1710/status/2080382035613405584?s=20

Hybrid, DBS check and UK Right to Work required. Closes 6 Aug 2026. Apply: https://careers.arsenal.com/jobs/8083296-research-engineer

Atom Computing | Many posititions | Boulder, CO/Austin, TX/Berkeley, CA | Some ONSITE, Some HYBRID

We're hiring software engineers, hardware engineers, RF engineers, FPGA and ASIC engineers, Optics/Mechanical/Optomech engineers, and Physicists with a background in atomic physics and/or characterization of quantum systems.

We trap Ytterbium atoms with lasers, and then use each atom as a qubit in a quantum register. A flash of green light accomplishes the quantum analog of a NOT gate. Two atoms held sufficiently close followed by a flash of UV light accomplishes the quantum analog of an XOR gate. The company is well funded and growing quickly. We have an endless supply of rich and interesting signal processing challenges. Atoms, famously used in atomic clocks, are very precise and sensitive to all the imperfections in your system. This makes for very demanding signal paths. Compiling programs for this architecture also involves interesting compiler challenges/optimizations. You'll have fun.

https://jobs.lever.co/atomcomputing

Stellar Science | Hybrid (USA) Albuquerque NM, Washington DC (Tysons VA), Dayton OH | Full time, interns/co-ops | U.S. citizenship required | https://www.stellarscience.com

Company: We're a small scientific software development company that develops custom scientific and engineering analysis applications in domains including: space situational awareness (monitoring the locations, health and status of on-orbit satellites), image simulation, high power microwave systems, modeling and simulation, laser systems modeling, AI/ML including physics-informed neural networks (PINN), human body thermoregulation, computer vision and image processing, high performance computing (HPC), computer aided design (CAD), and more. All exciting applications and no CRUD. We emphasize high quality code and lightweight processes that free software engineers to be productive.

Experience: Except for interns, we currently require a Bachelors degree in physics, engineering, math, computer science, or a related field. Masters or PhD is a plus. (Roughly 25% of our staff have PhDs.)

Technologies: Lots of C++23, Qt 6.9, CMake, git, OpenGL, CUDA, Boost, Jenkins. Windows and Linux, msvc/gcc/clang/clangcl. AI/ML and analysis projects use Python and C++. Web projects use Java and Typescript/React. We're a bit behind the curve on developer AI adoption, and we're okay with that.

Apply online: at https://www.stellarscience.com/careers/.

Preferred Networks | Tokyo or Remote in Japan | Full-time | https://www.preferred.jp/en

Preferred Networks is an AI company based in Tokyo working across the stack, from AI chips and computing infrastructure to LLMs and products. You may already know us indirectly if you've used software we've built, such as Optuna or CuPy (or Chainer, back in the day).

We are designing in-house chips (MN-Core series: https://mn-core.com/) and training LLMs (PLaMo series: https://huggingface.co/pfnet), and our team is actively hiring for two roles related to these endeavors:

- MN-Core LLM Serving Engine Engineer: Build software infrastructure to serve LLMs using our upcoming inference accelerator, MN-Core L1000. [Apply here: https://open.talentio.com/r/1/c/preferred/pages/121580]

- LLM Inference Optimization Engineer: Improve the inference engine powering our API service and maintain PLaMo implementations in open source projects such as vLLM. [Apply here: https://open.talentio.com/r/1/c/preferred/pages/119173]

Both roles require relocation to Japan. We are happy to provide visa and relocation support.

Elucid | Senior Security Engineer | Boston, MA | ONSITE (hybrid) | $130k–$170k | https://elucid.applytojob.com/apply/GaiNUaxbuO/Senior-Securi...

Elucid builds FDA-cleared AI software that analyzes cardiac CT scans to characterize plaque and predict heart attack and stroke risk. The world's best cardiologists use our output to make treatment decisions for real patients. As such, our platform is regulated as a Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) product by the FDA and we operate under HIPAA, ISO 13485, and ISO 27001.

We're hiring a Senior Security Engineer to help mature and scale our security engineering program: You'll work across application security, cloud infrastructure, and regulatory compliance, contributing to secure SDLC practices, threat modeling, code and design reviews, CI/CD security testing, AWS hardening and audit other activities to allow Elucid ship secure code quickly within a regulated SDLC.

We are looking for: 5+ years of experience in security engineering, application security, or a closely related software engineering role with a strong secure coding background, including fluency in cloud infrastructure security, common vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10 and beyond), authentication, and cryptography fundamentals. Healthcare or regulated-industry experience is a plus, but not a requirement.

Pantograph | San Francisco, CA | ONSITE | Full-time | Software Engineer, Mechanical Engineer, Research Scientist

Pantograph is a research lab developing generally intelligent robots with simple, scalable methods. We design and manufacture our robots in-house — we published full details on our robot today and opened the waitlist. It's an open, hackable robot: a full NixOS machine that runs any model, starting at about 4K. We'll be building thousands of them as we aim to collect 10M hours of on-embodiment robot data for our models.

We're a public benefit corporation. We care about transparency and openness, and we think a lot about what it would look like for robotics to go well. Some of our thinking on mission and impact is on our website: https://pantograph.com/

We're hiring across the hardware and ML research teams. We're looking for a great generalist SWE to work with our hardware team on our robot feature stack and improve our customer experience (Rust and Python, no robotics background required), a mechanical design engineer to take our first-generation robots from prototype through large-scale production, and research scientists with experience in large-scale pre-training, self-supervised RL, or video modeling.

Open roles: https://pantograph.com/careers

If you don't see the perfect role but you're excited about what we're doing, email hiring@pantograph.com with your background and what you'd want to do here.

Eleos Technologies (https://eleostech.com) | Remote Senior iOS Engineer | Permanently Remote (US-based applicants only) | Full time

Eleos Technologies is a growing company building communication software for truck drivers and the back-office workers who support them. We’re looking to scale up a second product engineering team to ship more advanced driver planning tools, automate outdated workflow, and a bunch of other wins to make drivers’ lives easier and more efficient.

We're looking for someone who has the experience to move fast on new stuff and knows how and when to pick their battles on old stuff. You'd be one of four iOS engineers at a company that's big enough to survive an economic downturn, but not so big you can't make immediate, direct impact that'll be seen and appreciated by the whole company. (We've also spent the last decade working really hard to make sure our tools, processes, and culture respect everyone's work/life balance. I'm the CTO and I don't text people on my team, and they don't text me, and that's true throughout.)

It's a native iOS app written in a mixture of Objective-C and Swift, leaning on Swift for new features. (But that said: if you chafe at the idea of maintaining or fixing bugs in battle-tested Objective-C that's paying our salaries, please look elsewhere!) We have about 1/3rd functional/UI automated test coverage and the rest is human-powered by our QA team.

If you're interested, please share your info via https://jobs.lever.co/eleostech/b4866f22-fab3-4f84-abec-6e74... and we'll get in touch!

Unitary Foundation | Member of Technical Staff, Fault Tolerant Quantum Compilation + Simulations | REMOTE (US) | Full-time

Unitary Foundation is a 501(c)(3) non-profit research group building a quantum technology ecosystem that benefits the most people. We build open-source infrastructure for quantum computing — current projects include Mitiq, UCC, and Clifft — and run community programs like microgrants and unitaryHACK.

We're hiring an MTS to help define and build our open-source compilation and simulation stack: compilation, simulation, error mitigation, resource estimation, benchmarking, and early fault-tolerant workflows. You'll join a small technical team doing research through sponsored collaborations with national labs, universities, and industry partners. The role is about technical ownership — forming a technical point of view, proposing roadmaps, and building tools that become useful shared infrastructure. There's also room to experiment thoughtfully with AI-assisted research workflows.

We're looking for a track record of building software other people use (ideally open source), a strong background in quantum computing (fault tolerance, error correction, compilation, simulation), and strong Python; C++/Rust is a plus. A PhD is one possible background for this role, but not required.

Apply at https://unitary.foundation/jobs/mtscs/

Klara Systems | https://klarasystems.com | Technical Marketing Engineer | Remote | Full-time / Contract

Klara Systems is a FreeBSD and ZFS engineering company serving enterprise customers across North America and Europe. Our team is senior, globally distributed, and operates with a high degree of autonomy.

We’re looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer who turns engineering work into technical content that helps buyers evaluate Klara’s services and provides engineers with useful, technically accurate resources. can find. You will interview engineers and consultants, mine incident write-ups, support cases, upstream PRs, mailing lists, and delivery lessons for source material, then turn that material into technical articles, pages, comparisons, FAQs, and migration guides. You will also build scripts and LLM-powered workflows to automate knowledge extraction, reporting, and first drafts.

You should have:

- A background in software development, systems administration, or a related technical field.

- The ability to hold a technical conversation with an operating systems or storage expert and turn it into something publishable.

- Daily experience using AI tools to produce technically accurate and high-quality assets.

- An understanding of technical buyer personas and how to build content they actually want to read.

- Lifecycle Marketing Manager: https://safetywing.pinpointhq.com/postings/fd7106ba-d53a-4a6...

Open roles:

Spore.Bio | Senior Software Engineer | Paris, France | Hybrid (Flexible)

Spore.Bio is a deeptech startup building a new paradigm in quality control for FMCG (Food & Beverage, Cosmetics, Pharma). We are replacing 200-year-old microbiology methods with advanced optics and deep-learning technologies to detect bacterial contamination directly on the factory floor in minutes, instead of days.

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and operate our core backend systems, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure. You will be a key technical contributor, building the systems that connect our cutting-edge optical instruments to cloud data platforms.

If you are interested in applying software engineering to real-world hardware and microbiology challenges, we'd love to hear from you!

Senior Python Backend Engineer | REMOTE (EMEA/APAC)

Chainguard | Product Manager, Scanner | REMOTE | Full-Time | https://www.chainguard.dev/

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. We build hardened, minimal, continuously-updated images, libraries, and packages that eliminate vulnerabilities before they ship — used by teams at Anduril, Canva, OpenAI, Snap, and Snowflake, among others.

We're hiring a PM to own the malware and greyware scanning engine inside Chainguard Repository — the system that analyzes source code, build behavior, and maintainer activity across the open source packages flowing through our platform to catch compromised or malicious artifacts before they reach a customer's environment. You'd own the roadmap for detection coverage, scanner accuracy (precision/recall trade-offs are the daily grind), and how findings get surfaced to security teams and translated into policy enforcement. Close partnership with our detection engineering and threat research teams, and with customers who are increasingly asking "how do you know this package is safe?"

Good fit if you've done PM work on a detection, fraud, spam, or security scanning system before, are comfortable being hands-on with data and false-positive/false-negative trade-offs, and want to work on a problem that's getting more urgent as AI agents pull in more open source dependencies automatically.

JD to be posted imminently but email me if interested and I'll route appropriately: patrick@chainguard.dev

AusRehab | Full-Stack Software Developer | Full Time | Sydney, Australia (Bankstown), hybrid | AU$120–160k

Apply online: https://www.ausrehab.com/careers/full-stack-ai-developer/
